item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 23/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure over the northern part of southern China will move towards the coastal areas and develop into a cold front in the next couple of days. The weather will become unsettled over the region. Showers will increase and there will be squally thunderstorms. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, the weather will be slightly cooler and it will still be rainy over the coastal areas early next week.

R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
